Exercise: Child's Pose

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
None

Force Type:
static

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- flexion
- extension_of_the_spine
- gluteal_contraction

Primary Muscles:

- lower back

Secondary Muscles:

- glutes
- middle back

Equipment:
None

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.75

Energy Requirement:
low

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- improve_flexibility_of_the_spine_and_hamstrings
- relax_and_decompress_the_lower_back

Contraindications:

- condition: knee problems, reason: Avoid this position if you have knee issues.

Exercise Variations:
None

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Seated Forward Bend, category: stretching

Instructions:

- Get on your hands and knees, walk your hands in front of you.
- Lower your buttocks down to sit on your heels. Let your arms drag along the floor as you sit back to stretch your entire spine.
- Once you settle onto your heels, bring your hands next to your feet and relax. "breathe" into your back. Rest your forehead on the floor. Avoid this position if you have knee problems.
